notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/9b87693b82b9dcd44ca5d447cf400417aaaa4ed1.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/379f027db323c8a81307953060fd108731eea560.png[/img][/url]
Hello everyone, I provide you with a small [b]1.9 [/b] update.

Additions
[list]
[*] Added new 3d mini-game - 'Basketball'
[*] Added lower floor
[*] Ability to sprint 'shift' key
[/list]

The next updates will be cosmetic. By popular demand I will add new clothes.

notes.title: Update 1.85
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/7cb20a97dd0c7279b23f8a4430e06ec525c5f301.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/92988e65adf9432c850b2a8aa39bcef728316ec9.png[/img][/url]
Hello everyone again, there is a new update [b]1.85[/b], which added a couple of new things.

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] [u]Now the old save is not supported! I apologize for the inconvenience. You can always go to menu-cheats to spawn any amount of money.
[/u]

Changes/additions
[list]
[*] Updated breast physics (nvidia physx)
[*] Added 2 settings to edit the shape of the breast
[*] Added the ability to remove clothes (to buy it, go to the shop)
[*] Added ability to walk. Click on the 'WALK' button on the top left corner
[*] Updated 3d models house and street
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/b154929a1f6839a9a141d8d25e0ba6b543a83dd9.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/9ea18ad2ebba3bd9189dbc53ad08c0de38861daf.png[/img][/url]
I welcome you all and announce the new update 1.7. The update list includes:
[list]
[*] Added a new pose "split". You can buy it at the store for $ 700.
[*] Added the ability to dance (top left corner select "Dance ($100)". While there are 3, but I'll add them! There is also a new room with a swimming pool for dancing.
[*] Fix bugs with saves
[/list]

Don't forget to suggest your ideas for the game in the discussions tab! Until next time!

notes.title: 1.6 Update is live
notes.content:
I present to you the new update 1.6!
Added:
[list]
[*] The ability to change the lighting of the lamp.
[*] Ability to change the time of day.
[*] Ability to remove HUD (all the inscriptions on the screen) using the key 'F1'
[*] Shadow enhancement
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Big update
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/8e8d23a7c97def0ba370d37f2cc3c8707d569f0d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/8b8522aeba080f1fafe257cab938ae5e4e2786f3.png[/img][/url] I am glad to announce the release of a new update. I hope you will like it.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new feature for the girl: [u]skin reflection[/u]
[*] Improve girl skin / chest
[*] Added [u]new pose[/u] for s*xual contact (Pose 6)
[*]Now you can take [u]unlimited amount of money[/u] if you do not want to earn! (You need to go to the 'menu' and select 'cheats' and press on 'Take' button) 1 button = 50$
[*] Chest physics fixed
[*] Added [u]realistic sounds[/u] during s*xual contact.
[*] Added more [u]realistic face[/u] animation during s*xual contact
[/list]

[b]See you later![/b]
